title: Vintage Caesars Palace Las Vegas Nevada Glass Ashtray Blue 3.5” diameter
descriptionText: This vintage Caesars Palace ashtray from Las Vegas, Nevada features a classic blue design with a diameter of 3.5 inches. Perfect for collectors of casino memorabilia, this ashtray captures the essence of the iconic casino theme. Made with durability in mind, this collectible item is sure to add a touch of nostalgia to any gaming enthusiast's collection.
